name: Tableau Cloud
description:
The Tableau Cloud connector for Claude leverages Tableau's hosted MCP Server to enable any Tableau Cloud user to seamlessly connect Claude to their Tableau environment. Use this app to:
- Chat with your data – Reuse your trusted, curated data models to answer ad-hoc questions that are grounded on your business semantics and metadata.
- Find insights from pre-built data artifacts – Enable Claude to query your published workbooks and extract data, images, custom views and more.
- Discover metrics and generate insights – Bring 100% accuracy and deterministic AI to Claude by using Pulse metric definitions and the Pulse insights engine.
- Manage and administer your Tableau environment.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Tableau Cloud to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Tableau Cloud to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.tableau.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Tableau Cloud MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tableau Cloud lists 23 MCP tools, including generate-pulse-insight-brief, generate-pulse-metric-value-insight-bundle, get-custom-view-data, get-custom-view-image, get-datasource-metadata, get-view, get-view-data, get-view-image, get-workbook, list-all-pulse-metric-definitions, list-custom-views, and list-datasources.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Tableau Cloud?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Tableau Cloud in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Tableau Cloud MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tableau Cloud requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Tableau Cloud is developed by Tableau. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
